texts.name: Yellow Brow King
texts.biography: Once the chime-bearing boy beneath Buddha Maitreya, he stole his master's treasures and slipped down to the mortal realm. There he built Little Thunderclap Monastery in imitation of the Great Thunderclap Monastery and dwelt within, masquerading as the Tathagata.

specialty.description: Based on hero level, the army's base Attack is increased by +1% per level; Attack granted by artifacts is increased by an additional +1% per level.
specialty.name: Attack Bonus
